title: Tumor immune profiles noninvasively estimated by FDG PET with deep learning correlate with immunotherapy response in lung adenocarcinoma.
summary: Publisher PDF Methods/Results report model training on FDG-PET to estimate tumor immune CytAct and tests in separate SNUH, TCGA and immunotherapy cohorts; modest retrospective associations bound the claim. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.

organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material
